name: AdGuard Home
shortDescription: Network-wide ad and tracker blocking DNS server.
about: AdGuard Home is a network-wide software for blocking ads and tracking. It operates as a DNS server that re-routes tracking domains to a 'black hole,' preventing your devices from connecting to those servers.
useCases: Ideal for network administrators and privacy-conscious users who want to block ads and trackers at the DNS level across all devices.

whyDeploy.title: Network-Wide Protection
whyDeploy.description: Block ads on all connected devices without installing any client-side software, running efficiently on just 2GB RAM.
